heading: Where I have real depth.
intro: Patterns I've shipped more than once and industries where I've operated long enough to know what actually moves the needle.

items.title: AI-native applications
items.description: RAG-grounded assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-first product surfaces. Built end-to-end, with the prompt engineering and inference-cost optimization to make them economical at scale.
items.evidence: MatchWise · Findably · Mexico por el Clima

items.title: Custom internal tools, ERPs & CMSs
items.description: When SaaS sprawl is the bottleneck — bespoke operational systems that replace five tools with one your team actually wants to use.
items.evidence: Rodada · Nova Realty · Mexico por el Clima

items.title: Fintech & payments
items.description: GTM, product, and integration work for venture-backed fintechs and payment-adjacent operations. Years across hyper-growth, consulting, and bank-side seats.

items.title: GEO & AI-search visibility
items.description: Generative-engine optimization end-to-end — from content architecture and citability scoring to building the tooling that gets sites cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Where most teams are still treating LLM traffic as an afterthought.

items.title: Inventory-driven platforms
items.description: Multi-tenant inventory architectures with self-serve CMS and structural SEO — patterns that translate from real estate to commodities to any catalogue-driven business.

items.title: Production web platforms
items.description: Every build ships as a web product in the end. Marketing surface, product app, admin tooling, all engineered together. Modern stack (Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Supabase), with SSR and performance wired in from day one rather than retrofitted at launch.

items.title: System-of-record integration
items.description: iPaaS-based integration layers that connect payments, billing, ERPs, and CRMs into a single operable ledger. The hours-back-per-week kind of work.

items.title: WhatsApp-first conversion (LATAM)
items.description: Conversion architectures designed around how Mexican and LATAM buyers actually transact — chat over forms, deep links over inboxes, SKU-aware messaging.
